create_mlp_model: create an MLP model with configurable hidden layers, activation function, and optional data whitening using Haiku
create_cnn_model: create a CNN model with configurable convolutional channels, kernel sizes, and optional data whitening using Haiku
create_resnet_model: create a ResNet model (versions 18, 34, 50, 101, 152, 200) with configurable channels and optional whitening
build_resnet_cifar10: build a custom ResNet class with 3x3 stride-1 initial convolution tailored for CIFAR-10 classification
apply_whitening_to_inputs: apply data whitening by subtracting mean and dividing by standard deviation on input tensors
